description: Volume drying up and price stabilizing — bottom formation detection
context: User asking about stocks where volume has dried up after a decline.
user_input_examples: 某某股票缩量止跌了，可以抄底吗？
成交量萎缩到地量了，是不是底部？

structure.analysis: Volume dry-up quality and duration evaluation
structure.risks: Falling knife vs genuine bottom risk

key_principles: Volume dry-up alone is insufficient; need price stabilization (narrow daily ranges)
Minimum 5 consecutive days of declining volume before considering bottom
Gap to previous high-volume day suggests capitulation selling has ended
Accumulation pattern (higher lows on low volume) is bullish confirmation
Sector peers should show similar stabilization for confidence

decision_tree.if_volume_dry_5days_and_higher_lows: Potential bottom, 1/4 position probe with tight stop
decision_tree.if_volume_dry_but_still_making_lower_low: Not bottom yet, wait for price stabilization first
decision_tree.if_volume_dry_with_sudden_spike_reversal: Strong bottom signal, can add position on pullback
